import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp')
import parse_modified as parse

# Test R1: 'l' type for letters only
print("=== R1: Letter type ===")
result = parse.parse('{name:l}', 'Hello')
print(f"parse('{{name:l}}', 'Hello') = {result}")
assert result is not None
assert result.named['name'] == 'Hello'

result2 = parse.parse('{name:l}', 'Hello123')
print(f"parse('{{name:l}}', 'Hello123') = {result2}")  # Should fail or match just 'Hello'
print()

# Test R2: __contains__ on Result
print("=== R2: __contains__ ===")
result = parse.parse('{} {}', 'hello world')
print(f"'hello' in result = {'hello' in result}")
print(f"'world' in result = {'world' in result}")
print(f"'foo' in result = {'foo' in result}")
print()

# Test R3: Brace validation
print("=== R3: Brace validation ===")
try:
    p = parse.Parser('{unmatched')
    print("ERROR: Should have raised ValueError")
except ValueError as e:
    print(f"Correctly raised ValueError: {e}")

try:
    p = parse.Parser('}{unmatched')
    print("ERROR: Should have raised ValueError")
except ValueError as e:
    print(f"Correctly raised ValueError: {e}")

# Valid braces should work
p = parse.Parser('{a} {{escaped}} {b}')
print("Valid format string works")
print()

# Test R4: FixedTzOffset
print("=== R4: FixedTzOffset ===")
from datetime import timedelta
tzo = parse.FixedTzOffset(5*60+30, 'IST')  # +0530
print(f"FixedTzOffset(+0530) offset: {tzo.utcoffset(None)}")
assert tzo.utcoffset(None) == timedelta(minutes=330)
print()

# Test R5: Fortran floats
print("=== R5: Fortran floats ===")
result = parse.parse('{val:f}', '3.14')
print(f"parse('{{val:f}}', '3.14') = {result}")
assert result is not None
assert result.named['val'] == 3.14

result2 = parse.parse('{val:e}', '1.23e-4')
print(f"parse('{{val:e}}', '1.23e-4') = {result2}")
print()

# Test R6: Hex/binary/octal
print("=== R6: Hex/Binary/Octal ===")
result = parse.parse('{val:x}', '0xFF')
print(f"parse('{{val:x}}', '0xFF') = {result}")
if result:
    print(f"  val = {result.named['val']} (type={type(result.named['val'])})")

result2 = parse.parse('{val:b}', '0b1010')
print(f"parse('{{val:b}}', '0b1010') = {result2}")
if result2:
    print(f"  val = {result2.named['val']}")

result3 = parse.parse('{val:o}', '0o77')
print(f"parse('{{val:o}}', '0o77') = {result3}")
if result3:
    print(f"  val = {result3.named['val']}")
print()

# Test R8: findall with case_sensitive
print("=== R8: findall case_sensitive ===")
results1 = list(parse.findall('{}', 'ABC abc ABC'))
print(f"findall('{{}}', 'ABC abc ABC') = {[r.fixed[0] for r in results1]}")  # Default case-insensitive

results2 = list(parse.findall('{}', 'ABC abc ABC', case_sensitive=True))
print(f"findall('{{}}', 'ABC abc ABC', case_sensitive=True) = {[r.fixed[0] for r in results2]}")
print()

# Test R9: Alignment space consumption
print("=== R9: Alignment space consumption ===")
result = parse.parse('{:<}', 'hello   world')
print(f"parse('{{:<}}', 'hello   world') = {result}")
if result:
    print(f"  fixed = {result.fixed}")

result2 = parse.parse('{:^}', '  hello  ')
print(f"parse('{{:^}}', '  hello  ') = {result2}")
if result2:
    print(f"  fixed = {result2.fixed}")
print()

# Test R10: Result slicing
print("=== R10: Result slicing ===")
result = parse.parse('{} {} {}', 'a b c')
print(f"result = {result}")
print(f"result[:] = {result[:]}")
print(f"result[0] = {result[0]}")
print(f"result[1:] = {result[1:]}")
print(f"result[-1] = {result[-1]}")
print()

print("All tests completed!")
